description: The Emissions Modeling Framework is a US Environmental Protection Agency client-server system for organising emissions-modelling data and workflows. It stores inventories and run settings, applies quality-control processes and tracks model input and output; its Control Strategy Tool estimates emission reductions and costs under alternative controls. Users supply emissions datasets, scenarios and method settings; outputs are managed runs, quality checks and control-cost estimates. Geographic coverage is selected by the inventory, with US air-quality applications documented by the provider. MIT source and links to the CMAS installation and usage materials are public. A limitation is that the framework does not create a validated emissions inventory and may require several server components and external datasets. It can support air-quality scenarios for roads and industrial facilities. The related catalogue ERA5 record supplies weather, not an EMF emissions run. No inventory or server package was downloaded.
